title: The Ledger of Drowned Bells
author: Barış Kısır
short_description: When probate archivist Ada Wren finds a will replaced by a rubbing of a drowned bell, she uncovers sixty years of forged inheritances in Greyport.
long_description: Probate archivist Ada Wren comes to Greyport to catalogue a century of sealed wills and instead finds a 1962 page cut out and replaced with a bell rubbing. Three church bells supposedly lost when St. Morven slid into the sea still ring in local legend, and five inheritance-linked deaths share one anniversary date. As Ada traces forged signatures to the town's founding shipping family, a midnight flooding and a smashed bell mould prove someone will drown the truth again. Only by finding where the bells really hang can she expose sixty years of stolen shoreline.
main_characters: Ada Wren - meticulous probate archivist hired to catalogue Greyport's sealed wills
Harlan Cobb - guilt-ridden retired bell-founder who cast an unrecorded fourth bell
June Ivers - sharp-tongued cafe owner protecting her family's claim to Cliff House
Silas Marne - charming harbormaster guarding four generations of forged inheritances
